Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but oil price jitters are adding some noise. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means even small swings can hit hard.
Your holdings: SOXL (-32.39%) and SPAL (-28.23%) are the clear SELL/TRIM signals needing attention. They're leveraged and decaying, and the losses are significant.
Watch: Keep an eye on how oil prices and geopolitical tensions (Iran/US) might indirectly affect broader market sentiment, even if your core holdings are tech.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and protecting your capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant loss and decay.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure due to the large loss and leveraged nature.
Consider QCOM (entry 196.62-196.33, stop 195.19) if you're looking for a new tech name with a strong scanner setup.
